BUG FOUND (blocking review-request scenario): in Settings > Driver > 'Your name' (testID set-driver-name) the value typed by the user is NEVER saved — the profile.driver_name stays null in backend after typing 'Alex Driver' and pressing Enter (submitEditing) or blurring the field. Confirmed by PUT /api/profile directly (works) — root cause is the RN Web onEndEditing behavior, not the render path.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing a name and blurring / pressing Enter does NOT persist driver_name to backend. onEndEditing on the RN Web Input at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:108-112 never fires, so updateProfile({driver_name}) is not called. Verified: after typing 'Alex Driver' and pressing Enter, GET /api/profile returns driver_name: null. When the field IS saved (via API), Home header correctly shows 'Alex'. Fix: add onBlur (or a save button, or onChangeText-debounced save). Suggested minimal patch: <Input ... onBlur={() => updateProfile({ driver_name: name.trim() || null })} onSubmitEditing={...} />.

react_native_issues.issue: onEndEditing does not reliably fire on RN Web — use onBlur/onSubmitEditing instead. Affects any settings-style 'save-on-blur' text field. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:111

rca_of_issue: Bug: driver_name typed in Settings never persists. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:111 uses onEndEditing on a react-native-web TextInput. react-native-web maps onEndEditing to native TextInput.endEditing which requires the platform blur/submit chain; on web it is not emitted on plain blur (mouse-click-away) and is only reliably emitted on Enter/submit for multiline, so mouse-first web users never trigger the save. Reproduction (verified): 1) open /settings, 2) type 'Alex Driver' into set-driver-name, 3) click elsewhere or press Enter, 4) GET /api/profile?profile_id=... returns driver_name: null; 5) Home header still shows 'Today'. Fix: use onBlur (fires reliably on RN Web and native) or add an explicit save action. When the fix lands, the render path is already correct — verified by direct PUT of driver_name → header updated to 'Alex' after reload.
